subscription-list.title: Subscriptions
subscription-list.empty: No subscriptions yet. They appear here when customers subscribe at checkout.

subscription-detail.subtitle: Subscription
subscription-detail.past-due: The last renewal could not be paid. Renewals are on hold until the customer chooses a working card.
subscription-detail.pending: Waiting for the first payment to be authorized.

plan-list.title: Subscription plans
plan-list.empty: No plans yet. Add a plan to offer Subscribe & Save on products.

plan-detail.subtitle: Subscription plan
plan-detail.applies-help: Customers can subscribe to these products and to every product in these categories. When several plans match a product, the plan with the highest priority wins.

order-now.title: Order now?
order-now.message: This places a renewal order right away and charges the saved card.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription?
cancel.message: The customer won't be charged for this subscription again. They will receive a cancellation email.

process-now.title: Process this renewal now?
process-now.message: This ignores the reminder and cutoff times: the order may be placed and charged immediately.

plan-delete.title: Delete plan?
plan-delete.message: Existing subscriptions keep their frequency and discount, but customers can no longer subscribe with this plan.

placeholders.search-subscriptions: Search by number, product, SKU or customer
placeholders.search-renewals: Search by number, order or customer

permissions.product-subscription:update: Change, skip, pause, resume and cancel subscriptions
permissions.product-subscription:renewals:process: Process renewals, order now and retry payments

Enabled.title: Subscriptions enabled
Enabled.description: Show Subscribe & Save offers in this store

ReminderLeadDays.title: Reminder lead time, days
ReminderLeadDays.description: How many days before each delivery the reminder email is sent

CutoffHours.title: Cutoff, hours before delivery
CutoffHours.description: After this point prices are re-checked and the order is placed

RetryScheduleHours.title: Payment retry schedule, hours
RetryScheduleHours.description: Comma-separated delays between payment retries after a temporary decline

PaymentActionWaitDays.title: Days to wait for customer action
PaymentActionWaitDays.description: How long to wait for 3-D Secure confirmation or a review before failing or skipping the renewal

Version.title: Subscription terms version
Version.description: Change it when the terms text changes; customers accept the new version at checkout

Text.title: Subscription terms text
Text.description: Shown before the payment fields at checkout (US auto-renewal disclosure)

Enabled.title: Send yearly reminder
Enabled.description: Required in California, Minnesota and Connecticut

CronExpression.title: Renewal scheduler cron
CronExpression.description: How often renewals are checked (restart required)

AuthorizationLifetimeMinutes.title: Mock payment authorization lifetime, minutes
AuthorizationLifetimeMinutes.description: Shorten to test re-authorization before capture
